lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are organized into approximately five distinct horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with spot diameter increasing towards the posterior mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Well-defined vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with horizontal spot rows to create a rectilinear grid-like configuration on the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three primary longitudinal ridges are visible; the most dorsal ridge exhibits a high-contrast transition from high-intensity luminance on its upper surface to a deep shadow gradient on its lower surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The visible silhouette of the first dorsal fin contains a sparse distribution of high-luminance blobs, primarily clustered near the leading edge and base.

other_distinctive_markers: Two elongated, low-luminance silhouettes (likely remoras) are visible attached to the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
